column1: # Complete package source evidence for parser-mysql-package.

column5: The complete charset defaults, exact 223-entry bidirectional collation authority, UTF-8 classifier, and executable RangeGraph membership contract are transcreated from pinned Go Unicode tables with a reproducible checked generator.

The complete protocol constants, command names, SQL-mode bitset and expansion rules, priority conversion, authentication constants, coreos-compatible TiDB X version conversion, and coherent runtime-mutable release/server version authority are transcreated with typed Rust APIs.
The complete generated MySQL error-code table is retained as the Rust error-code authority and is validated for generated source parity.
The complete 952-entry MySQL error-message and redaction-position catalog is retained as the Rust message authority and validated for generated source parity.

SQLError construction, SQLSTATE fallback, catalog formatting, typed Go-format diagnostics and primitive verbs, redaction modes, unknown-code fmt.Sprint spacing, and display text are transcreated through typed FormatArg values and Go-oracle matrices.

All locale tables and number-grouping branches are transcreated; SQL callers supply the same non-empty ASCII decimal strings, while impossible empty Rust inputs return a typed error instead of preserving a Go indexing panic.
The complete privilege bit identities, names, user columns, SET spellings, reverse lookups, and ordered scope sets are transcreated from mutable Go maps into one immutable Rust authority.
The complete generated SQLSTATE table and HY000 fallback are retained as the Rust SQLSTATE authority and validated for generated source parity.
Every MySQL type code, field flag, and flag predicate is transcreated with the exact numeric representation and behavior.
Integer classification, default field dimensions, CAST dimensions, and the historical clear-text authentication-plugin classification are transcreated exactly.
